Hello, I'm Nora

I've seen hiring from both sides of the table.

After several years in recruitment and career consulting, working directly with hiring managers at international companies across Europe, I know what employers look for — and what it feels like to be the one waiting for the call.

I've also lived through burnout myself. That's why my work is practical and honest, and always human.

About

Nora Judit Suto

I'm a career strategy and burnout coach, outplacement consultant, and resilience trainer.

For several years I worked in recruitment and career consulting, partnering directly with hiring managers at international companies across Europe. I've seen how decisions are really made on both sides of hiring — and I've supported many clients through transitions, job searches and interviews.

I've also lived this world myself: interviewing, changing direction and experiencing burnout first-hand. That mix of perspectives is what I bring to every client — individual or company.
